h1: Custom Frosted Awards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom frosted awards in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for employee recognition and corporate milestones.
introHtml: Frosted awards offer a sophisticated, etched-glass look that adds a refined touch to any recognition program. Unlike clear crystal, the frosted finish diffuses light softly, making engraved text and logos stand out with elegant clarity. Whether you are honoring a sales achievement with the Iceberg Summit Award or celebrating a team milestone with the Music Notes Award, these pieces convey lasting value. Perfect for HR directors and business owners seeking professional, bulk-ordered awards that feel substantial without being flashy.
heroAltText: Custom frosted awards including the Optical Globe, Music Notes Award, and Iceberg Summit Award for corporate recognition
